default/30409.htm.text: Earth Snake: Wait! Do not be fooled by my appearance, I am not a mere basilisk. I am the spirit of earth that studies the principles of the world on the ground. Right now I am looking for a way to purify the negative forces that have seeped into the earth in these ruins.

Q00228_TestOfMagus/30409-01.html.text: Earth Snake: I am an element of this earth. The truths of the universe within the earth are within me. So, you seek the Note of the Earth? What do you expect to do with it...? Do you plan to create absolute music? Is that it...? And what then...?
when: state STARTED; has items 2847; lacks items 2859,2863

links.text: "I will use it to bring the thousand year flower into bloom."

Q00228_TestOfMagus/30409-05.html.text: Earth Snake: 1, 2, 3... Yes... I think you have brought all that I asked for. I shall bestow upon you the Note of the Earth. May you create beautiful music with this and make the thousand year flower bloom...
when: state STARTED; has items 2847,2859,2863; hasItemsAtLimit(player, ENCHANTED_MONSTER_EYE_SHELL, ENCHANTED_GOLEM_POWDER, ENCHANTED_IRON_GOLEM_SCRAP)

Q00228_TestOfMagus/30409-04.html.text: Earth Snake: There are not 10 items here...Did you think I would not notice? I will not give you the Note of the Earth until you bring me proof that you have slain 10 each of the Enchanted Monster Eye, Enchanted Stone Golem and Enchanted Iron Golem.
when: state STARTED; has items 2847,2859,2863; !hasItemsAtLimit(player, ENCHANTED_MONSTER_EYE_SHELL, ENCHANTED_GOLEM_POWDER, ENCHANTED_IRON_GOLEM_SCRAP)

Q00228_TestOfMagus/30409-06.html.text: Earth Snake: Have you acquired the notes of water, wind, and flame? The Note of the Earth is a deeper and more solemn tone than the other notes... Only when the 4 different notes combine together can the most beautiful music be played... The absolute music...
when: state STARTED; has items 2847,2859,2863; lacks items 2863

Q00404_PathOfTheHumanWizard/30409-01.htm.text: Earth Snake: Wait! Do not deceive yourself into thinking I am a mere lizard just because I look like a basilisk. Although my appearance is unremarkable, I am a spirit of earth, which studies the principles of the world embodied within the soil and rock. Right now I am looking for a way to purify th…
when: state STARTED; has items 1288; lacks items 1289,1291; !(qs.isCreated() || qs.isCompleted())

Q00404_PathOfTheHumanWizard/30409-02.htm.text: Earth Snake: If you want to receive the token of earth from me, bring me back Red Soil. The Red Soil contains the strong vitality of the earth and can be obtained by hunting the red bears that are frequently seen in the Fellmere Harvesting Grounds between the Ruins of Agony and the Orc Barracks.
when: state STARTED; has items 1289; lacks items 1290; !(qs.isCreated() || qs.isCompleted()); !(hasQuestItems(player, WATER_NECKLACE) && !hasAtLeastOneQuestItem(player, RUSTY_COIN, EARTH_RING))

Q00404_PathOfTheHumanWizard/30409-03.htm.text: Earth Snake: You've brought the Red Soil! So fast for a Human! I thought you would have more trouble than that. As promised, I'll exchange the Ring of Earth for a Token of Earth. Don't lose the faith, pilgrim. Once you've collected the tokens of fire, water, wind and earth, speak with Parina in Glu…

Q00404_PathOfTheHumanWizard/30409-04.htm.text: Earth Snake: Once you have collected all four tokens - fire, water, air and earth - that represent the four elements of nature, go find Parina in Gludin Village. Her deep understanding of the elements and spirits can lead you towards enlightenment.
when: state STARTED; has items 1291; lacks items 1289; !(qs.isCreated() || qs.isCompleted()); !(hasQuestItems(player, WATER_NECKLACE) && !hasAtLeastOneQuestItem(player, RUSTY_COIN, EARTH_RING))

Q00228_TestOfMagus/30409-02.html.text: Earth Snake: Ahhh, the thousand year flower! I see... So you seek the golden seed and the 4 elemental notes, then? Well, I guess it doesn't matter... Yes, I will give you the Note of the Earth. But you must find out something for me first. In that place that the Humans call Oren, near the Ivory Tow…

Q00228_TestOfMagus/30409-03.html.text: Earth Snake: Enchanted Monster Eye, Enchanted Stone Golem, Enchanted Iron Golem... These are the monsters you must slay. You must kill them and bring me what they carry... and plenty of it! Ten! Yes! Ten from each will do! Take this totem with you as a reminder of your promise...
